name: Undermind
summary: AI research assistant that reads full texts and figures to find and cite relevant papers.
description: Undermind runs in-depth searches of the scientific literature, reading full texts and figures and citing every source, then keeps results in a library that grows as research continues. It can be connected to AI agents such as Claude and ChatGPT.
